justification: The function uses strlen(helper->name) as length parameter in strncmp without ensuring info->name is properly bounded, allowing potential buffer over-read if helper name is longer than expected.
analysis: The function reads the helper name from info->name which is user-supplied data from netlink attributes. It uses strncmp with strlen(helper->name) as the length parameter, but does not validate that info->name is null-terminated or within bounds before passing it to strncmp. The helper name comes from a netfilter match rule configuration and could be crafted by an attacker.
